intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season, late booking dan surcaj 2027 dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Kadar transport ikut kawasan dan kelas kenderaan (Avanza 2–4, Innova 5–6, Hiace 7–12) — pilih blok itinerary supaya kadar hari tambahan berlabuh pada kawasan yang betul. Pindah bandar guna blok Pindah bandar: ia mengenakan full day tour dan transfer, seperti nota rate card. Untuk malam peak yang guna hotel 4★, pilih Naik taraf hotel 4 bintang – malam peak season pada baris hari itu (RM90 upgrade + RM5 beza peak).

paxNotes.text: 2–4 pax: Toyota Avanza / APV — kadar transport band 2–4 pax
5–6 pax: Toyota Innova — kadar transport band 5–6 pax. Naik taraf ke Hiace RM100/pax (add-on).
7–12 pax: Toyota Hiace — kadar transport band 7–12 pax. Bas tidak digunakan untuk Bandung kerana jalan sempit; van maksimum 12 pax.
13 pax ke atas: melebihi satu Hiace — perlu lebih satu kenderaan. Rate card operasi tidak menyiarkan kadar untuk band ini, jadi kadar transport akan papar kadar?. Minta sebut harga operasi.

validity: Validity of Quotation: This quotation is valid for 24 hours from the date of issue and is subject to hotel and room availability as no space has been secured. A deposit of RM 250 per pax is required upon confirmation, with full payment due 45 days before departure. Prices are quoted in Malaysian Ringgit and may change with the prevailing currency exchange rate. Itinerary, price and flight schedule are subject to change due to weather, traffic and operational conditions — the Jakarta to Bandung road journey takes approximately 3 to 4 hours and heavy traffic is common. Final itinerary and hotel confirmation will be issued 14 to 21 days before departure. Guests carry their own luggage on the Whoosh train. Free activities are non-exchangeable for other activities, vouchers or cash if not taken up. This package is valid for travel until 31 December 2026.
